card.name: No prior experience required
card.fires_on: Words in requirement phrases just before 'experience' or 'knowledge', such as 'No prior', 'any prior', 'without', and 'but' after 'open to non-majors'. It also fires on the digit 7 in 1700s birth years.

modes.label: Prerequisite phrasing
modes.description: Words like prior, without or basic that lead into 'knowledge' or 'experience required'.
modes.example: No<< prior>> filmmaking or film studies experience required.

modes.label: Eighteenth-century years
modes.description: The digit 7 after '1' in birth years of the 1700s.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words like experience, knowledge, familiarity and prior.
card.plain: It fires where a text says what background is or isn't needed, such as 'no prior experience', and on the 7 in years like 1719.
